title: Review finding
description: One problem the review agent reports. Severity words come from REVIEW.md.

id.description: F1, F2, ... in the order reported. Stable within one review.

severity.description: Important: bug, security hole or break for the core project; fix before merge. Nit: worth fixing, not blocking; at most five per review. Pre-existing: a problem not introduced by this change; becomes a Jira ticket.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file (the right side of the diff). For Pre-existing findings, the line as it is at the head commit.

body.description: What goes wrong, for which input or state, and the smallest fix. Markdown.

rule.description: The REVIEW.md 'Always check' rule (or CLAUDE.md section) this finding enforces, quoted briefly. Empty when none applies.
